voice_prompt: A deep American male voice with the calm restraint of an elite operator who speaks only when he means it. General American accent, low-mid pitch, intimate control, and protective steadiness suited to Navy SEAL romance, bodyguard romance, and emotionally guarded heroes. He should sound observant, self-contained, and deeply dependable, with warmth emerging naturally rather than performatively. Avoid stiffness, avoid monotone flatness, and avoid melodramatic gravel.
preview_text: A quiet tactical American protector voice with low warmth, restraint, and intimate control.
